modern: On the occasion of each single thing that you do, pause and ask yourself if death is a dreadful thing because it deprives you of this.
original: Severally on the occasion of everything that thou dost, pause and ask thyself if death is a dreadful thing because it deprives thee of this.
notification: On the occasion of each single thing that you do, pause and ask yourself if death is a dreadful thing because it deprives you of this.
notification_original: Severally on the occasion of everything that thou dost, pause and ask thyself if death is a dreadful thing because it deprives thee of this.

explained.summary: With each thing you do, stop and ask: is death really so terrible because it would take this away from me? The honest answer often shows how little the activity matters, and how much of your fear of death is attached to things that don’t deserve it.
explained.today: Try it mid-scroll, during a petty argument about whose turn it was to empty the dishwasher, or while refreshing your inbox for the fifth time. Few of these are things you’d mourn losing.
